_comment: WO-930 PROOF GRAPH - the owner's one-room stairwell. Deliberately the smallest graph that changes floors: a room, the StairwellRoom, a room. No encounters, traps, keys, locks or chests - if this fails to path, it is the stairwell, because there is nothing else it could be. Compare against dg_descent_probe, which is the SAME test under the old _Up/_Down pair model and reports PathPartial with 0/1 ramps whole. The two graphs exist side by side ON PURPOSE: one number against another is the only honest way to say whether the new model is better. Keep this minimal; it is a probe, not content.
